label: docker-up retry loop, foreground (real session)
command: open -a Docker 2>&1; for i in $(seq 1 40); do docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "docker up after ${i}x3s"; break; }; sleep 3; done; docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "docker still down"

label: pg_isready retry loop, foreground (real session)
command: docker compose up -d postgres 2>&1 | tail -5; for i in $(seq 1 20); do docker exec $(docker compose ps -q postgres) pg_isready -U app >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "pg ready"; break; }; sleep 2; done; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}'

label: until grep exit= on a background task output file, foreground (real session, used 6 times)
command: until grep -q "^exit=" "$SCRATCH/tasks/bc3xtttir.output" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 3; done; grep -n "Sheet:\|strategy\|exit=\|error\|Error\|lookback" "$SCRATCH/export.log" "$SCRATCH/tasks/bc3xtttir.output" | head -30

label: nested gh pr view mergeable poll inside a per-PR loop, foreground (real session)
command: cd "$REPO"; for n in 8 9 10 11; do for i in $(seq 1 12); do st=$(gh pr view $n --json mergeable,mergeStateStatus -q '"\(.mergeable)/\(.mergeStateStatus)"'); [ "${st%%/*}" != "UNKNOWN" ] && break; sleep 5; done; echo "#$n pre: $st"; case "$st" in MERGEABLE/CLEAN|MERGEABLE/UNSTABLE|MERGEABLE/HAS_HOOKS) gh pr merge $n --merge 2>&1 | tail -1; sleep 4; gh pr view $n --json state,mergedAt -q "\"#$n \(.state) mergedAt=\(.mergedAt)\"";; *) echo "#$n NOT merged: $st";; esac; done

label: bare sleep 90 then gh pr view, foreground (real session; the harness itself blocked this one)
command: sleep 90; cd "$REPO"; for n in 227 228 229; do gh pr view $n --repo owner/repo --json state,mergedAt,baseRefName -q "\"#$n \(.state) base=\(.baseRefName) mergedAt=\(.mergedAt)\""; done; gh pr view 228 --repo owner/repo --json comments -q '.comments[-1].body' | head -12

label: push then poll mergeable with sleep 5, foreground (real session)
command: git push -q origin feat/reconcile 2>&1 | tail -1; cd "$REPO"; for i in $(seq 1 12); do st=$(gh pr view 9 --json mergeable,mergeStateStatus -q '"\(.mergeable)/\(.mergeStateStatus)"'); [ "${st%%/*}" != "UNKNOWN" ] && break; sleep 5; done; echo "#9 pre: $st"; case "$st" in MERGEABLE/*) gh pr merge 9 --merge 2>&1 | tail -1;; *) echo "#9 NOT merged: $st";; esac

label: background watcher that never exits on its condition (while true, no break)
command: while true; do gh pr view 228 --json state -q .state; sleep 15; done
